description: Duration and easing tokens as declared in tailwind.config.js. Per-section MEASURED motion lives in motion/motion-spec.json — these are only the reusable primitives.

DEFAULT.usage: every link/state hover on the site; header theme swap; mega-menu panel

350.usage: platform featureCallout link label swap (opacity + translate)

DEFAULT.usage: site default; header, mega-menu, every hover

ease-out.usage: logo-banner reveal, mega-menu panel + hover arrow

expressive.declaredIn: component code, not the Tailwind theme
expressive.usage: accordion panel height, pinned-section stage transitions — the site's one 'expressive' curve

orbit-letter-reveal.measured: after an instant jump-scroll the lit count keeps climbing ~1.2s with no overshoot; residual decays with tau ~= 215ms. Dominant pole 4.75 rad/s -> tau 210ms.

reducedMotion.mechanism: A single global CSS rule: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .letter-reveal-char { opacity: 1 !important } }`. That is the ONLY reduced-motion handling in the real source.
reducedMotion.gap: HONEST GAP: the real build implements reduced-motion for exactly one effect (the orbit letter reveal). Every other section's `reducedMotionFallback` in this design-repo is a PRESCRIBED contract for generated pages, not a description of existing source behaviour. It is required by the schema so generated output cannot omit it; it is not a claim that the clone already does it.
